samples.question: The two-cell domino starts in the numbered bays shown; the magenta ring marks one end. Read the five arrow cards from left to right. Each arrow tries to roll the domino one bay in that direction. A successful roll shifts the domino one bay and swaps its two ends. An arrow that would cross an edge does nothing, including no end swap. Which bay contains the marked end after all five cards? Answer 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
